description: List an account's events: upcoming (default), past or archived. Each has its slug, title, dates, location, currency, live/test_mode flags and public URL. Tito: GET /:account/events, /events/past, /events/archived.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

page_size.description: Results per page (page[size]), 1-1000. Tito's default is 100.

scope.description: Which events: upcoming (default), past or archived.

name: tito_list_events
title: List events
